description: Training a pretrained model further on input-output examples (conversations in its chat format) of the behavior you want.
Updating every weight. Most expressive, about 16 bytes per parameter of GPU memory with Adam in mixed precision, and a full model copy per fine-tune.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: freeze the base model and train a small number of new parameters (LoRA, adapters, prompt tuning). Also the name of Hugging Face's library.
Low-Rank Adaptation (Hu et al., 2021): learn ΔW = B × A with small rank r for chosen weight matrices; the frozen base plus a small adapter.
LoRA on top of a base loaded in 4-bit NF4, with double quantization and paged optimizers (Dettmers et al., 2023). Fits large models on one GPU.
The small set of trained parameters a PEFT method produces. Merged into the base for zero overhead, or kept separate and swapped per request.
Losing prior abilities (general reasoning, languages, safety behavior) after training on a narrow task. Measured with a regression suite beyond the task.
Memorizing the training set: training loss keeps falling while the eval score gets worse. Watch the eval, not the loss.
